data.description:
Add a shared "hand this to your agent" affordance: a copyable, plain-language brief written TO an agent, offered on the operator surfaces where a capable agent does the job faster than a human clicking. PHILOSOPHY §3 claims every capability is reachable programmatically and that we ship the affordances that make agents effective — this is that claim made visible in the product instead of asserted in a document.

STRICTLY ADDITIVE — operator ruling, 2026-08-12. Every surface keeps its existing UI in full. A brief is an extra path, never a replacement, and never a licence to simplify away a control to make room. A screen that loses a working affordance to fit a brief has failed this ticket. Even on People → import, where the brief leads visually, the file-drop stays and must work standalone.

WHAT A BRIEF CONTAINS — all four, or it is not paste-ready:
1. Where this instance lives — the real URL of the running deployment, never a placeholder.
2. The machine-readable entry point, told as an instruction: "read /api/openapi.json first".
3. The auth path — an API token, and where to mint one (Settings → API tokens).
4. A definition of done: what to report back, including any undo handle (e.g. import_id).

A brief that omits auth sends the operator's agent into a 401. A brief that omits the definition of done gets a "done!" with no receipt. Both are failures of this ticket, not of the agent.

SURFACES — one brief each, written for that job. These are copy, not a template with holes; a generic brief with the nouns swapped is a fail:
- People → import (already prototyped: prototypes/crm/index.html, the "Import people" modal — reproduce it one-to-one)
- CFP setup → build a call for papers from a description of the conference
- Communications / chase → find who is behind and send the right nudge
- Agenda builder → place the accepted sessions, respecting conflicts
- Speaker portal, organizer side → prepare and send a speaker's onboarding

SHAPE: one shared presentational component (brief text + full-width Copy button + the muted "or drive it yourself" endpoint line), five pieces of per-surface copy. Clipboard via navigator.clipboard with a visible confirmation; a select-all fallback where it is unavailable. Voice per DESIGN.md — the brief is written as the operator would speak to their own agent, first person, no exclamation marks.

BOUNDARIES: no new dependencies. Not a chat panel, not an in-app assistant, no model is called and nothing leaves the browser — Marquee renders text the operator copies. The endpoint reference stays a muted single line, not a second code block.

READ FIRST: PHILOSOPHY.md §3; DESIGN.md (voice, craft rules); prototypes/crm/index.html "Import people" modal; SKILL.md and cli/generate-skill.mjs for the vocabulary the briefs should echo.

PROCESS: fresh worktree off github/main; PR via gh pr create --repo Stage-11-Agentics/marquee --base main. Post-deadline scope — do not merge before the competition freeze clears (cf. MRQ-105).
data.title: Hand this to your agent — copyable agent briefs on operator surfaces

data.body:
PR open, DO NOT MERGE (post-deadline, human-gated per MRQ-105): https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/marquee/pull/95

Shipped the shared agent-brief component plus four briefs — CFP setup, Communications/chase, Agenda builder, Speaker portal (organizer side). Strictly additive: one trigger button per surface, no control removed, moved, resized, or disabled; confirmed by driving all four screens in a real browser against a seeded local Worker, and pinned by a test that fails if a later edit deletes one of the named controls.

People → import untouched — that screen and its brief are MRQ-131's. AgentBriefPanel is exported standalone so MRQ-131 can consume it inside the import modal it owns.

Gate: pass, 36.5s of a 120s budget (fast suite 29s of 45s).

VALIDATION — running system, real browser (c11 embedded WKWebView), not a test double.

Environment: local Worker at b087980 then f9fe9bc (npx vite build → wrangler dev --local, migrated + seeded AIE NYC data, INSECURE_LOCAL_COOKIES:1), organizer seat via demo login. Ports 8830/8831/8832 — 8787 was held by a sibling agent and was left alone.

All four surfaces driven:
- CFP forms (/forms) — trigger renders; overlay opens; brief reads correctly with the live origin substituted (http://localhost:8830, not a placeholder); Copy succeeds and the label swaps.
- Communications (/communications) — trigger renders in the banner; brief correct.
- Agenda builder (/agenda-builder) — trigger renders; brief correct.
- Onboarding (/onboarding) — trigger renders; brief correct.

Additive, confirmed on screen per surface (nothing removed, disabled, or resized):
- CFP: Duplicate, + New form, Close form/Reopen/Publish changes, 7-step rail, add-field row, field editor, Save form, Save field, Live preview.
- Comms: Demo-safe banner + default: demo_safe chip, 9 template cards with toggles, Template/Ad-hoc switch, Subject, Body, 10 merge fields, Save template edits, counted selector, preview, triggers, filters, outbox.
- Agenda: ⚠ 7 conflicts, Publish the program, Review publication, canvas, unscheduled pool.
- Onboarding: Import speakers, Invite to portal (n), Send reminder (n), 507-row chase board and drawer.

Elements never jump: Copy button measured 552x30 in idle, copied, and post-revert states.

Night theme re-lights the panel with the shell (screenshot taken); no literal colors in the new stylesheet, asserted by test.

Post-review re-validation (f9fe9bc): aria-label present on the brief block, no id on it, the label element is a span, and the visually-hidden status region announces once then clears to empty while the button box stays 552x30.

Gate: npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-130 → pass, 56.0s of a 120s budget.

Code review: PASS (art_01KZVAYZGAENXSF05RH1K96G8W). Three real findings fixed in f9fe9bc; the vacuous Agenda guard was verified negatively — stripping the conflicts button takes setConflictsOpen(true) from 1 to 0 while the old assertion 'conflicts' stays at 34.

MERGED by operator instruction (Atin, 2026-08-12): PR #95 squash-merged to main as f605a51. Remote branch deleted.

The gh CLI returned a GraphQL error on the merge call; the mutation had in fact succeeded and only the response failed, so the merge was confirmed against git rather than assumed from the exit code.

Verified after merge: all 9 files present on main, both post-review fixes landed (aria-label on the brief block, the non-vacuous Agenda guard), and pr-gate run against merged main passes at 37.6s of a 120s budget.

Note for whoever picks up MRQ-131: it is now the one to reconcile. Its worktree inlines a lookalike panel in src/ui/people/PeopleModals.tsx whose brief opens 'Marquee is at this site' — the placeholder this ticket forbids. AgentBriefPanel is on main and exported for exactly that use.
